metric_definitions.BCE: mean sigmoid binary cross entropy from logits; positive class only for positive frame labels
metric_definitions.ambiguous: fully excluded; frozen test inventory contains zero ambiguous frames
metric_definitions.counter_reset: episode start/end, non-consecutive index, invalid/missing image, inference failure, or input validity failure
metric_definitions.frame_metric_threshold: frozen detector probability threshold tau=0.83; metrics are pre-latch
metric_definitions.minimum_postcompletion_positive_run: shortest nonzero threshold-positive run at/after completion within an episode; 0 if none
metric_definitions.shortest_postcompletion_positive_run: minimum nonzero post-completion threshold-positive run over all episodes
metric_definitions.shortest_sustained_postcompletion_run_ac: minimum across episodes of each episode's maximum post-completion threshold-positive run; matches validation calibration convention
metric_definitions.trigger: current fifth consecutive valid p_t>=tau frame; never backfilled; latched within episode
